Reconstructed templates for the synthetic capture requests. The <record-name>
placeholder stands for a distinct record name per API. Object metadata, reader
setup and permission assignment match ../source/steps.txt and its metadata.

Commit this record in one anonymous request:
insert new ProbeAccess__c(Name='<record-name>');

In a later anonymous request, run at API 68.0:
User u=[SELECT Id FROM User WHERE Alias='probeusr' LIMIT 1]; ProbeAccess__c rec=[SELECT Id FROM ProbeAccess__c WHERE Name='<record-name>' LIMIT 1]; List<UserRecordAccess> a=[SELECT RecordId,HasReadAccess FROM UserRecordAccess WHERE UserId=:u.Id AND RecordId=:rec.Id]; System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR,'OBS|row='+a.size()+':read='+(a.isEmpty()?'missing':String.valueOf(a[0].HasReadAccess)));

In a later anonymous request, run at API 67.0 with the same code except for:
SELECT RecordId,HasReadAccess,HasEditAccess FROM UserRecordAccess
